author: Nelev
body:
A new theme for the chat: warm porcelain rather than blue-grey, deep consult green as the primary, and a serif wordmark — the register a private clinic uses rather than a hospital portal. **Style only**, with one exception noted below.

## Type

| Role | Face | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Display | Instrument Serif | the wordmark |
| UI | Instrument Sans | everything else |
| Mono | JetBrains Mono | record id, severity codes |

## The canvas

Two wide blooms in the brand hue, and a six-beat ECG rhythm traced low across the width, passing behind the panel. Drawn once rather than tiled, so nothing repeats; each beat is a P wave, a QRS spike and a T wave.

It is an inline SVG held in a `--trace` custom property, because a data URI cannot read a colour token — which also means each mode inks its own: `#10a05e` in light, `#34e39b` in dark. The green a monitor draws a rhythm in, not the ink green the rest of the interface is set in.

## Three decisions worth the review

- **Coral is its own token, not `--accent`.** Components reach for `--accent` as a hover wash, so putting the one urgent colour there would have splashed it across every hover. `--pulse` is spent on exactly three things: the live dot, the send control, and an `S1` answer, which takes a coral rule down its left edge where every other answer has a green one.
- **`panel-lit` is an `@utility`, not a class in `@layer components`.** Only a utility can take the `sm:` variant the panel applies it with; a component class there generates nothing at all and fails silently.
- **Light is the default.** The `dark` class comes off `<html>`. The dark tokens stay complete behind it and are a genuine second design, not the light one dimmed.

## The one non-style change

**The severity finally shows.** It has been stored with each assistant turn and returned in the payload since the API started triaging, and the UI dropped it on the floor. `ChatMessageProps` now carries `severity?`, `ChatMessages` passes it down, and the bubble renders the code with the label the prompt's own table gives it — `S1 emergency` through `S5 informational`.

## Verified

Driven against the running dev server, not a mock. Asked "do i have any allergies?" and got the real answer back with an `S5 INFORMATIONAL` chip under it. Checked in both modes and at 375px, where the panel goes full-bleed and wraps cleanly.

Typecheck, lint, Prettier, 23 tests and `next build` all pass. No handler, store, prop or API call was touched; the composer's `handleSubmit` is byte-identical.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
